core_obligations: Dispatch finite and flat by faithful descent; surjective by BL-faithful vanishing

Etale via the fibre comparison and flat + fp

proof_roadmap.step: Dispatch finite and flat by faithful descent; surjective by BL-faithful vanishing
Finite type via two-sided generators; fp via descent on the presentation kernel
Etale via the fibre comparison and flat + fp

difficulty_reason: Translate to algebra: for glueable A, B the properties P' of A_f -> B_f and A ⊗ R' -> B ⊗ R' hold iff A -> B has P'. Finite and flat come from faithful descent + the BL flatness lemma; surjectivity from the BL-faithful vanishing of N = B/A; finite type from choosing generators working on both localizations ('small detail omitted', one-line adjustment) plus the surjective case; fp from the kernel I being finitely generated by descent applied to the presentation ideal; etale from fibre comparison (fibres of Spec(B) -> Spec(A) are fibres of the two localizations) giving unramified, plus flat + fp already shown.

compared.note: Property-transport workhorse of the BL section; the omitted generator adjustment is a one-liner.
